name: io.github.singhsrikrishna3-afk/chartix
description: NSE equity analysis from ChartixAI: OHLCV bars, detected chart patterns with Chartix's own backtested win rates, screener runs, watchlists, alerts and chart deep links.

environmentVariables.name: CHARTIX_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A Chartix login JWT from POST /api/auth/login. Chartix issues no API keys, and this token carries the user's full authority including writes.

environmentVariables.name: CHARTIX_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Chartix API base URL. Defaults to https://api.chartixai.com
